title: SWF compile: scene RemoveObject2 tags emitted before FrameLabel (spec violation)
description: For scenes N>0 in compile.ts, RemoveObject2 tags are emitted (lines ~1357-1363) before the FrameLabel for the new scene (line ~1483). Per SWF spec §1.3.2, FrameLabel should precede any display-list modification tags within the same frame. Ruffle likely tolerates this but it deviates from spec. Fix: move the FrameLabel emission to before the RemoveObject2 block.
